observed_issue.body:
The initial complete Staphyloferrin B candidate contains two sequence locators that cannot resolve against its cited original UniProt batch. The batch root contains `results`; it has no root-level `sequence` member. The underlying sequences and the qualified assembly assertions remain supported.

| Evidence | Current sequence pointer | Required pointer | Accession |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sbn-edge-056`, evidence[1] | `/sequence/value` | `/results/0/sequence/value` | Q2G1M5 |
| `sbn-edge-058`, evidence[1] | `/sequence/value` | `/results/1/sequence/value` | Q2G1N2 |

Initial target SHA256: `891ce5a5ba08bfae8fdedbd7709f14097f4bd04749c7755fce6d6a51841c840a`.
Original batch SHA256: `15afa127c1bc378d3cf2fc5335160aa03afb08136150d15386a22d9b6951ee6e`.
Stable issue key: `staphyloferrin-b-uniprot-batch-sequence-locators`.
Severity: minor provenance defect.

Acceptance criteria:

- Preserve the initial target, source projection and canonical review unchanged in the research/review record.
- Correct these two pointers and create explicitly linked current source-projection metadata; retain every other scientific field.
- Verify that the corrected pointers resolve to the exact source accessions and sequences, and that the original bad pointers and wrong-entry pointers are rejected.
- Obtain independent correction acceptance and a final scientific successor that links the original finding. Retain the complete seven-transform pathway and all strain, construct, assembly and endpoint qualifications.

Initial canonical observation: `20261011T144835Z-staphyloferrin-b-initial-independent-review`, finding `f-uniprot-batch-sequence-locators`. The immutable pair is saved in the prepared candidate worktree at `reviews/structured/20261011T144835Z-staphyloferrin-b-initial-independent-review/`; it will accompany the candidate PR. YAML SHA256: `91f17d5ec7b5f24ef91d58f85e5352c7569446f34d7eacec37a931cf393a9729`. Canonical validate/save/check exited 0; this initial review remains partial/needs_curation, not publication approval.
observed_issue.title: Correct two UniProt batch sequence locators in the Staphyloferrin B candidate
